statusReason: The pilot depends on the security review: Billing is finished, but the review found two issues. The pilot can start on time only if they are settled this week.

accomplishments.text: Billing: Customers can view invoices, pay by card and get refunds on the test site.
Orders: Order history and search passed testing with no serious faults.
Pilot: Forty customers from three regions agreed to take part.
Training: The first draft of the support team's guide is ready to review.

upcomingGoals.text: Security review: Fix or agree a plan for the two issues it found.
Load test: Check the portal copes with two thousand customers signed in at once.
Way back: Practise returning to the old site on the test site.
Pilot: Send the invitations once the load test passes.

peopleAndProcess.text: Pilot go-ahead: The steering group to approve the pilot at its next meeting.
Contact centre: Free up four staff for half a day of training before the pilot.
Holidays: The lead tester is away next week, and cover is arranged.

technology.text: Security team: Tell us which of the two issues must be fixed before the pilot.
New features: None go in once the pilot starts: only bug fixes from then on.
Email: Sending limits are raised ahead of the pilot invitations.
